summary: Regression testing passed for all public backend endpoints and fixture-specific prediction content. Mobile layout has no horizontal overflow, but sidebar navigation links are not clickable at 390px because main content intercepts pointer events.

ui_bugs.issue: Navigation link clicks time out because the main page content overlays/intercepts pointer events over the collapsed sidebar.

action_items: Fix mobile sidebar stacking/positioning so collapsed navigation links receive pointer events; retest all mobile routes.
critical_code_review_comments: At max-width 650px, aside has no explicit position/z-index while main content can paint over it, blocking navigation interaction.
seed_data_creation: None; curated fixtures, odds, predictions, and analytics are MOCKED by the backend and no bookmaker credentials are configured.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoint regression and f-002 fixture detail semantics passed. Mobile overview and detail load without horizontal overflow; verify sidebar navigation after z-index/position fix.
rca of the issue: At 390px viewport, clicking [data-testid=nav-portfolios] is intercepted by the main .page element. The collapsed aside remains in normal flex layout without a stacking rule, allowing main content to cover the clickable sidebar region.
